sources: Sportmonks IPL ball-by-ball cache, 2013-2026 (data/ipl). Seasons with 200+ balls faced (405). 11 measures, z-scored within each season; distance = Euclidean across the 11. Dismissals counted for the player out (bowled rows carry no out_id; non-striker run-outs included). analysis/lab_twin.py, make_lab_twin.py

short.vo: There's nobody like अभिषेक शर्मा. Or is there? We built a model to find his statistical twin.
Step one. Eleven measures, from every ball he faced in twenty twenty-six. Each one is ranked against the thirty batters who faced two hundred balls or more.

scene.title: 11 measures.
scene.sub: IPL 2026 · percentile v the 30 batters with 200+ balls
scene.foot: IPL ball-by-ball, Sportmonks · seasons with 200+ balls faced, 2013-2026 · super overs excluded · analysis/lab_twin.py

short.vo: He's second for strike rate. Second in the powerplay. Second against pace, and second against spin.

scene.title: Second, again and again.
scene.sub: IPL 2026 · percentile v the 30 batters with 200+ balls
scene.foot: IPL ball-by-ball, Sportmonks · seasons with 200+ balls faced, 2013-2026 · super overs excluded · analysis/lab_twin.py

short.vo: The catch? He's out every twenty balls. Only four of the thirty got out more often.

scene.title: The catch.
scene.sub: IPL 2026 · percentile v the 30 batters with 200+ balls
scene.foot: IPL ball-by-ball, Sportmonks · seasons with 200+ balls faced, 2013-2026 · super overs excluded · analysis/lab_twin.py

short.vo: Step two. We measured the same eleven things for every IPL season since twenty thirteen. Four hundred and five of them.

scene.title: Every season.
scene.label: Every IPL batting season with 200+ balls faced, 2013 to 2026
scene.foot: IPL ball-by-ball, Sportmonks · seasons with 200+ balls faced, 2013-2026 · super overs excluded · analysis/lab_twin.py

short.vo: Then we measured how far each season sits from his, across all eleven at once. Most are a long way off. A typical season sits five point eight eight away.

scene.title: One distance.
scene.sub: from Abhishek 2026 · all 11 measures · lower = more alike
scene.foot: IPL ball-by-ball, Sportmonks · seasons with 200+ balls faced, 2013-2026 · super overs excluded · analysis/lab_twin.py

short.vo: Fifth, ऋषभ पंत in twenty eighteen. Fourth, Travis Head. Third, Ryan Rickelton. Second, पंत again, in twenty seventeen. And the closest of all?

scene.title: Top 5.
scene.foot: IPL ball-by-ball, Sportmonks · seasons with 200+ balls faced, 2013-2026 · super overs excluded · analysis/lab_twin.py

short.vo: Glenn Maxwell, in twenty twenty-three. Almost the same strike rate against pace. Out every eighteen to twenty balls. A six every seven balls or so. The difference? अभिषेक is quicker overall, and far quicker against spin.

scene.title: Glenn Maxwell, 2023.
scene.foot: IPL ball-by-ball, Sportmonks · seasons with 200+ balls faced, 2013-2026 · super overs excluded · analysis/lab_twin.py

short.vo: His distance from Maxwell: one point six two. A typical season: five point eight eight. More than three and a half times further away.

scene.title: 3.6 times closer.
scene.foot: IPL ball-by-ball, Sportmonks · seasons with 200+ balls faced, 2013-2026 · super overs excluded · analysis/lab_twin.py

short.vo: And before you ask. We dropped each measure, one at a time. Maxwell stayed on top, all eleven times. We lowered the bar to a hundred and fifty balls. Still Maxwell. And on Maxwell's own list, number one is अभिषेक.

scene.title: Three checks.

rows.label: Drop any one of the 11 measures

scene.foot: IPL ball-by-ball, Sportmonks · seasons with 200+ balls faced, 2013-2026 · super overs excluded · analysis/lab_twin.py

short.vo: One more thing. His twenty twenty-four season? Its closest match is Maxwell too. From twenty fourteen.

scene.title: Twice.
scene.foot: IPL ball-by-ball, Sportmonks · seasons with 200+ balls faced, 2013-2026 · super overs excluded · analysis/lab_twin.py

short.vo: So, he isn't one of a kind. He's the Big Show, opening the batting. Who should we put in the lab next? Tell us in the comments.

long.description: The Lab, Episode 1. We measured Abhishek Sharma's IPL 2026 season on 11 measures, then compared it with all 405 IPL batting seasons (200+ balls) since 2013. The closest match is a surprise, and it holds up when we stress-test the model.
